summary: Firefox enhanced GPU-accelerated video decoding by adding Vulkan Video support for VP9 and AV1 codecs with improved queue handling and memory layout management, updated FFmpeg to version 63 for better codec support, and hardened content protection synchronization to prevent race conditions. **DRM-protected video playback is now safer** with stricter access control on the content protection manager and CDM proxy, and object-stream handling in platform-specific decoders now validates sizes to prevent memory issues.
